tools.name: world-spawn-tool-20261018.json
tools.description: Spawn a new VRChat world. First things first: a public GitHub repo, then a link with a cute one-line summary in the Findastra profile README (by pull request). Then a Unity project skeleton copied from a working reference world: packages and the embedded VRChat SDK, project settings renamed for the new world, the agent queue and a README. Preview by default; never writes into an existing folder or merges anything.
